title: Two RAG failures
summary: Which legs of the RAG triad fail when retrieval or the answer is ungrounded.

choices.text: Both failures are answer relevance. Context relevance is BLEU of the answer against a reference.
Neither failure is in the triad. The triad is precision, recall, and F1 of the final token.
Context relevance failed on the wrong-product passages. Faithfulness failed when the answer added a rule the passages do not support.
Faithfulness failed on the wrong-product passages, because retrieval is a generation error. Answer relevance failed on the invented refund rule.
